answer: Stake to wander: each new identity posts a bond reclaimable only after epochs of honest work. On a bare mesa the attacker's gain is diluted across sybils while the cost of idle bonds compounds. A sybil ring on tundra-cold capital loses more to frozen stakes than it extracts; honest agents reclaim their bonds. Equilibrium: attack only pays when bond cost drops below per-identity loot, and bonds rise to prevent that.
